metric_definitions.goal_adequacy_at_observed_boundary: The actually delivered exchange answers the immediate goal or gives a useful and explicit clarification/limit/cancellation outcome. It does not mean completion of an official municipal transaction.
metric_definitions.strict_facts_and_language_including_publ: All delivered customer text plus concrete exposed reviewable submission parameters preserve supplied facts and supported capability boundaries. Includes draft identity fields, even if the draft is later cancelled.
metric_definitions.delivered_final_facts_and_language: Narrow final-answer-only factual/language check, reported separately so deterministic host safety does not conceal incorrect earlier drafts.
metric_definitions.presentation_readability: Readable message formatting, language context, no raw duplicated JSON/Markdown or literal escaped-newline breakage. Not a claim of perfect product tone or latency.
metric_definitions.combined_quality: A case passes only if goal-boundary adequacy, strict facts/language including drafts, and presentation readability all pass.

observed_outcome_statistics.counting_note: Case labels overlap. Waiting includes eight actual pending inputs and two explicit conversational target choices; a negative result may invite optional correction without being classified as a required continuation. Own reads include honest target-negative/privacy checks. Limits/refusal/cancel/waiting are not completed government transactions.

model_and_guard_observations.interpretation: Host-case/host-submission/host-guidance text is deterministic output correctness, not unrestricted primary-model factual accuracy. Primary still chooses goals, plans, tools, parameter values and guidance codes. Both gates approved the incorrect name draft; some discarded raw finish prose still invents photo type/uploader. findings.category: A full name is duplicated to populate two required identity fields in an actual confirmation draft
findings.assessment: Only one complete name was supplied, without explicit independent identical first-name/surname fields. Copying that entire value twice changes the combined identity. A later cancellation protects state but does not make the displayed draft semantically valid. Do not infer actual false submission.
findings.recommendation: Use source-aware name provenance and a normalized full-name/parts consistency check. Explicit separately supplied equal name parts must remain allowed. If only an undivided full name cannot be mapped safely, ask for the needed parts; do not hardcode Han surnames or prohibit equal names.
findings.historical_correction: The same duplication exists in the preserved v7 and v6 initial cancellation drafts. Earlier reviews focused on cancellation/no-write and missed it. findings.category: Trusted guidance replaces a blocked/no-write answer and drops the original request noncompletion result

findings.assessment: Primary finish prose explains the unavailable matching type and that the original physical report was not registered, but that prose is replaced. No mismatched record or unauthorized write occurred, but the user does not get an explicit outcome for the requested report.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the current requested-item outcome when finish is blocked and no current-task write succeeds. Keep partial successful receipts acknowledged in mixed goals.

arguments.message:
شكرًا على التوضيح. هذه الخدمة محاكاة محلية فقط، ولا يُرسَل أي بلاغ إلى جهة رسمية ولا توجد متابعة أو إشعار فعلي.

بالنسبة لبلاغ «ألعاب مكسورة في الحديقة قرب بيتنا»: الخدمات البلدية المتاحة هنا لا تتضمن نوعًا يخص ألعاب الحديقة أو تجهيزاتها. التصنيف الفرعي الوحيد المتاح تحت «صيانة المساحات العامة» يتعلق بسطح الطريق، ولا أرغب في تسجيل بلاغك تحت نوع لا يطابق مشكلتك.

ما يمكنني فعله بدلًا من ذلك:
• تسجيل شكوى عامة بصياغتك أنت (ألعاب مكسورة في الحديقة قرب بيتنا) — وهي خدمة مختلفة عن بلاغ الصيانة، وتُسجَّل محليًا فقط.
• أو إبلاغك بأن هذا النوع من البلاغات يحتاج قناة رسمية منفصلة عن هذه المحاكاة.

هل ترغب في تسجيل شكوى عامة بهذا المعنى؟ وإن أردت، يمكنك إضافة اسمك ووسيلة تواصل ورقم الهاتف والبريد إن رغبت في ذكرها.
